process.description: We check all moving parts, including springs, rollers, hinges, cables, and tracks. We look for wear, damage, and potential points of failure specific to Des Plaines homes.
We apply garage-door-specific lubricant to all appropriate parts. We adjust tension and alignment for smooth, quiet operation. This includes checking for rust near damp slabs.

After service, we perform a balance test to ensure the door is weighted correctly. We also test the safety-reverse mechanism to confirm it functions as designed, providing safety for your family.
